text:
incident-bot: PAGER — elevated p95 for route /v1/generate in us-west-2. P95 increased ~2.3x vs baseline. No mass 5xx, some tail 504s. Paging ops-oncall.

priya: acked. I'm on my way, starting trace + perf captures.

ken: I'm on-call lead. Priya + Mike, swap artifacts. Priya: please capture perf counters (sched, cs, softirq) and collect one 30s eBPF sample. Mike: confirm whether the kernel node-patch was applied to prod nodes during the 04:00 deploy window.

mike: Confirmed: kernel upgrade (linux-6.2.14 -> 6.3.1 backport) rolled to prod nodes at 04:12 UTC as part of node image update. Staging had rollback at 02:30.

priya: Starting eBPF capture now. Command:
```bash
sudo /opt/tools/bpftrace -e 'profile:hz:997 /comm=="redwood-inference"/ { @[stack] = count(); }' -o /tmp/ebpf.stack
sudo perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30
``` 
Also collecting perf counters:
```bash
sudo perf stat -e cycles,cpu-clock,cs,migrations,context-switches -p $(pgrep inference) sleep 30
```

ella: Support update: 12 customers reported sluggish responses between 04:20-04:36, 2 customers saw request timeouts. Raising priority on CS tickets.

ops-oncall: noted. Can someone attach logs+trace id bundles to this thread when available?

priya: Uploaded trace bundle to the secure bucket: s3://redwood-incident-traces/1933332121/tracebundle.tgz
Trace UI: https://traces.internal/trace/abcd1234 (sample spans: kv_cache_lookup 118ms, model_decode 42ms, scheduler_wait 96ms)

ken: Timeline draft:
- 04:00 UTC: Batch node image rollout begins
- 04:12 UTC: kernel backport applied to 60% nodes
- 04:17 UTC: p95 for /v1/generate begins rising
- 04:22 UTC: paging alerts trigger
- 04:30 UTC: mitigation rollouts (disable auto-batching + fallback model)
- 04:35 UTC: p95 trending back down

ken: Hypotheses:
1) Kernel preemption/scheduling behavior introduced increased context-switching leading to KV cache thrashing.
2) Node image change altered futex/cgroup interactions impacting pinned threads (affects batching latency).
3) Independent: traffic pattern change causing cold KV cache misses; but traces show scheduler_wait spans inflated.

mike: Perf counters from one affected pod (prod-xyz):
```
# perf stat summary
cycles: 1.2e+11
context-switches: 84234
migrations: 540
cpu-clock: 28.7
```
Context-switches ~2.5x baseline.

priya: eBPF stack sample top frames show high sched_yield / futex_wait loops.

ken: Immediate mitigations applied at 04:30:
- Disabled request auto-batching for /v1/generate on us-west-2 (rollout id: r-9876)
- Pinned inference threads to isolated cores on 20% of nodes
- Rolled model variant to v1.2-fallback for heavy customers

ken: Can someone run a short canary to verify p95 improvement? @priya please run synthetic load 5rps for 5m against canary nodes.

priya: Canary run started. Initial p95: 420ms -> after mitigations p95: 130ms within 6 minutes.

ella: Customer impact note: CS informed customers A/B; two customers auto-retried and recovered. No data loss.

mike: Still seeing elevated migrations on some hosts. Opening infra ticket to rollback kernel backports on the remaining nodes if trending continues.

ops-oncall: Do we want to declare Sev2? Current impact limited but multiple customers affected.

ken: Declaring Sev2 to coordinate RCA. Assigning action items:
- priya: collect full perf+ebpf artifacts and upload (done)
- mike: verify node image rollout state and prepare rollback playbook
- ella: compile customer timeline and notes
- ken: write initial incident timeline in postmortem doc

priya: Artifacts uploaded. Links:
- s3://redwood-incident-traces/1933332121/tracebundle.tgz
- https://perf.internal/record/trace-1933332121

ken: Closing live mitigation: p95 back within 1.05x baseline at 04:40. Keeping Sev2 for RCA.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as active - assigned to ken (oncall). Next update in 30m or when RCA complete. :rotating_light:
